B: Every substantive source, knowledge, review, and log record carries OKF 0.1 and BoI Profile 0.1-local metadata with specialized local types.
Nineteen source records preserve filenames, source kinds, exact SHA256 values, source_refs, and generated_from; the 03/09 duplicate is represented once with both paths.

result.rationale: B wins narrowly because its per-source evidence records, indexed review queue, history-preserving maintenance, and structured failure paths are more complete. A provides the better direct comparison and final-count UX, but its malformed source-08 SHA256 is a material objective provenance defect. Neither output crosses a hard-failure boundary: both include the required profiles, preserve unsupported claims as unresolved, keep sensitive and blocked types Local, and leave promotion unconfirmed.
